Path to qualified comparison

Independent acceptance gates remain open. Specification generation study has started: 3 documents, 200 supplied pages, 27 assigned calls across three serving configurations, including stopped and incomplete requests. Current completion and accounting appear on the specification generation page.

Six acceptance gates and current status
  1. Real procurement document families

    Build licensed, source-hashed procurement packs spanning tens of pages, with amendments, precedence, exceptions and cross-document conflicts. Use 60–85% only as a development difficulty diagnostic after the metric is valid; never tune or select the sealed test to force that range.

    Status: 3 public documents, 200 supplied pages; development-exposed
  2. Document-to-specification generation

    Make open generation from documents the primary task. Assess atomic rules, actors, guards, exceptions, data constraints, provenance and omissions against expert gold. Seeded-statement classification remains a secondary diagnostic.

    Status: 27 assigned calls; collection stopped; completion reported in generation results
  3. Blind domain annotation and adjudication

    Freeze the contradiction versus not-established rubric first. Two procurement experts annotate independently without model outputs or identities; a third adjudicates. Retain pre-adjudication labels and publish per-category agreement, disagreement and unresolved cases.

    Status: Two annotators and a third adjudicator needed
  4. External selection and sealed custody

    An external custodian selects new source families and controls sealed gold and access. Everything already public or inspected during development remains development material. Publish verified role and conflict disclosures, dated commitments and access receipts.

    Status: No external custodian appointed
  5. Seeded-defect measurement validation

    Run a preregistered study with human-adjudicated faithful controls and semantic defects. Report detection TP/(TP+FN), false alarms FP/(FP+TN), abstentions, parsing failures and missingness separately, with uncertainty by source family and error category.

    Status: Independent metric-validation study not executed
  6. Replicated comparisons and uncertainty bands

    Freeze comparable resource conditions, model/provider versions, full serving settings and retry rules before calls; collect at least three repetitions. Aggregate by independent document family, estimate paired uncertainty and keep missing responses separate. Assign an ordering only after preregistered practical-effect and multiplicity-controlled uncertainty criteria are met; otherwise show unresolved comparison bands, not forced ranks.

    Status: No qualified bands or ranks
